desc: Parse input (N, weights, intervals, Q, queries) and build coordinate-sorted arrays: one sorted by R with prefix-min weights, one sorted by L with suffix-min weights.

Implement O(log N)-per-query case analysis: direct edge if disjoint; else base W_s+W_t plus min of (common-neighbor via left/right, cross left-right and right-left), returning -1 if no valid candidate.
Verify against both sample inputs (hand-traced: 11/6/-1 and 157/124/-1/114/114) — all match.
Ideation: exploit interval-order structure (2+2-free ⇒ no induced P5 ⇒ optimal path is an induced path of ≤3 edges) to derive the prefix/suffix-min formula.

Reasoning audit: confirm positive weights ⇒ min-weight path is chordless; common neighbor cannot straddle; same-side length-3 cases are dominated by a cheaper common-neighbor path; cross-case intermediates are automatically adjacent and distinct; -1 iff disconnected.
